## About
Clipper's Tree Service is Eric and his crew, working on trees around Austin from our spot on Banister Ln. We trim, we take down dead and rotted trees, and we clean up the ground before we leave.
Some of our neighbors have had us out for years. As one customer put it, "It’s hard to find a company you can count on year after year." Clipper's Tree Service holds a 4.4 rating from 39 Google reviews, and we'd be glad to earn yours.

## Services
- Tree trimming: Shaping and cutting back the trees around your house, whether it's your own idea or your HOA's.
- Cleanup and haul-away: When the cutting is done, we clean up the ground and haul the debris away.

## FAQ
Q: Do you give free estimates?
A: Yes. Estimates are free, and we'll meet or beat a competitor's price.

Q: Will you clean up when you're done?
A: Yes. Customers tell us we leave everything looking clean after the job.

Q: My HOA says my trees need trimming. Can you help?
A: Yes. One customer called us for an HOA trim, and we were ready to do the job the next day.
